Scaled-Down Triage and Queue Management: The Contractor shall provide support services during core business hours (0800 to 1700 ET, Monday through Friday, excluding federal holidays). To allow analysts/developers to balance user support with active agile sprints, support will be primarily asynchronous and managed via the approved ticketing system (e.g., Remedy). Functions include monitoring the ticket queue, performing root-cause analysis on user-reported issues, resolving data or user-error issues directly, documenting troubleshooting activities, and translating systemic bugs or feature requests into the agile development backlog for Government prioritization. Initial Response (SLA): Acknowledge and log all support requests within four (4) business hours. Requests received after hours/holidays must be acknowledged within the first two (2) business hours of the next business day. Ticket Processing: Maintain detailed logs of all troubleshooting and communication inside the ticket. Process and resolve tickets based on Government-established mission priority (Critical, High, Medium, Low) rather than chronological order; priority shall be assigned in accordance with definitions and criteria in the QA
